# UltraTextGen — Symbol & emoji library

> Browse the UltraTextGen Library — an A–Z directory of 146 reference collections covering Unicode symbols, emoji, and formatting guides. Search, filter by use case or platform, and jump to any letter.

339 pages under https://ultratextgen.com/library/, in en. Site index: https://ultratextgen.com/llms.txt. Complete canonical URL list: https://ultratextgen.com/sitemap.xml

## Symbol & emoji library

- [Unicode reference library](https://ultratextgen.com/library/): Browse the UltraTextGen Library — an A–Z directory of 146 reference collections covering Unicode symbols, emoji, and formatting guides.
